svg.text: A month of noise at station TMU: every hour of January 2026 (vertical sensor)
Each hour's spectrum adds a little ink: dark where many hours fell, pale where few did.
the quietest places on Earth (low-noise model)
white line: the median hour (half the hours were quieter)
Shaking power is ground acceleration in decibels: 10 dB more is 10 times the power, about 3 times
bigger shaking; 20 dB more is 10 times bigger shaking.
